original.statement: Error handling for ApplicationSet-generated applications now uses the default requeue behavior instead of a previous non-default requeue strategy.

decision.reason: [ev-a0994163965b] states that errors on ApplicationSet-generated apps should now use the default requeue, which is a runtime behaviour change of the appset controller with no configuration change; behavior-changed (before/after optional) fits. The subject name is built from the evidence's own key words (appset, generated app, errors, requeue), and protocol-behavior is the closest family for this runtime-only behaviour. Confidence is low because the evidence is only a commit title and the component is inferred from the "appset" scope.
